selectionGates: role exists in the source catalog
license and redistribution posture are explicit
repository revision and every acquired file SHA-256 are pinned
live acquired or adopted bytes match the pinned SHA-256
blockedBehavior: Unresolved provenance, license, runtime provisioning, or checksum evidence blocks selection without substituting another model.
catalogEvidencePolicy: The catalog is packaged as source metadata. Packaging and CI do not refresh or claim the catalog's machine observations.
